//: High/critical advisories that CI is allowed to ignore, each with a reason and the date it was reviewed. Nothing goes here because a build was red; it goes here when there is no fix and the risk is understood.

allowed.reason: SheetJS stopped publishing to npm at 0.18.5; the prototype-pollution and ReDoS fixes only ship in 0.20.x from the vendor CDN. The package is used only to parse broker spreadsheets the signed-in user uploads themselves, never third-party input, so both advisories need a malicious file the owner chose to import. Migrate to the 0.20.x tarball or swap to a maintained reader before letting anyone else upload files.
